edition.notes: Public domain by age (1881 imprint). The scan is a user-contributed copy of an identified imprint; its searchable text layer is poor and should be used for navigation only, but the scan does carry page images and these are the authoritative reading. Correction recorded 2026-07-25: an earlier state of this note reported a discrepancy between the reproduced imprimatur formula 'Nihil obstat: imprimatur. Datum Lycii ex Curia Ep. die 15 Nov. 1879. Vicarius Generalis, Carmelus Arch. Cosma' (p. 22) and Bishop Zola's letter of 24 May 1880 in the same volume, whose text layer reads 'le 18 novembre 1879' (p. 31). Page-image collation of both pages on 2026-07-25 shows that the letter reads 'le 15 novembre 1879'; the two witnesses agree and the discrepancy was an artifact of the text layer. Consumers who recorded the discrepancy should review. Two items remain unresolved: an ambiguous two-digit number at p. 9 ('pendant plus de 33/35 ans'), and the title page's description of Zola as spiritual director 'depuis 1867' against his own 'de 1868 jusqu'en 1873' at p. 31. No image or copy of the 1879 Lecce imprint that this volume reprints has been reached. Exact scan bytes not retained in the repository.

alternate_titles: L'apparition de la tres Sainte Vierge sur la sainte montagne de La Salette le 19 septembre 1846
work.author: Melanie Calvat (Soeur Marie de la Croix)
work.description: The expanded first-person text attributed by Melanie Calvat to the apparition of 19 September 1846, subscribed by her at Castellammare on 21 November 1878, printed at Lecce in 1879 under a diocesan Nihil obstat: imprimatur, and reprinted at Louvain in 1881 with a preface, two of her recent letters, and a letter of Salvatore Luigi Zola, Bishop of Lecce and formerly her spiritual director. A further reprint (Societe Saint-Augustin, Paris-Rome-Bruges, 1922) was proscribed and condemned by the Holy Office on 9 May 1923 with an order to withdraw copies from the faithful; the Holy Office had already, on 21 December 1915, commanded all the faithful not to discuss or treat of the so-called Secret de la Salette. This record exists so that the document's identity, printing permission, and custody chronology can be cited accurately. Its content is not summarized here and is not the object of any approval. Loci are the parts of the 1881 volume and its printed page numbers.
work.title: Le secret complet de la Salette, publie par Melanie de la Salette, Soeur Marie de la Croix
